answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock ivory staking collateral to harvest network nectar, establishing a dynamic opportunity-cost barrier. By routing identity verification through a zero-knowledge walnut verifiable delay function, the subgame-perfect punishment matrix guarantees that any attempt at identity multiplication yields a strictly negative expected utility.
